questions.scenario: You and your friends are playing a highly intense squad match in BGMI or Free Fire. What is your role?

options.A: I am the frontline assaulter, aggressively pushing into the enemy's building first and taking the hits.
options.B: I constantly check the mini-map, calculate the blue-zone timing, and suggest the safest tactical route.
options.C: I am the designated sniper or driver, spotting enemies from far away with lightning-fast reflexes.
options.D: I am the In-Game Leader (IGL), telling my teammates exactly when to attack, hold, or fall back.

questions.scenario: You are watching the Republic Day Parade on TV with your family. What gives you the most goosebumps?

options.A: The marching contingents in perfect synchronization, stepping with heavy boots and immense stamina.
options.B: The massive BrahMos missiles, radar systems, and high-tech weapon displays rolling down Kartavya Path.
options.C: The spectacular Sukhoi and Tejas flypast, making thrilling, high-speed formations in the sky.
options.D: The thought of how the organizers perfectly coordinated thousands of troops, bands, and floats without a single mistake.

questions.scenario: You join the school's NCC (National Cadet Corps) or the sports team. What is your favorite part?

options.A: The tough physical drills, running rounds of the ground, and doing push-ups in the hot sun.
options.B: Learning how to read top-sheet maps or figuring out how the walkie-talkie frequencies work.
options.C: The rifle shooting practice, focusing deeply and aiming precisely at the bullseye.
options.D: Being the Parade Commander or Team Captain, holding the flag/sword and shouting commands.

questions.scenario: Your group is organizing a trekking trip to a nearby hill station. How do you contribute?

options.A: I carry the heaviest rucksack, clear the bushes on the path, and physically lead the climb.
options.B: I manage the compass, GPS apps, and accurately calculate how many kilometers we have left.
options.C: I operate the camera or drone, finding the best scenic viewpoints and capturing the action smoothly.
options.D: I plan the entire itinerary, collect the 'chanda' (money), and allocate food and water to everyone.

questions.scenario: It's the final over of a tense Gully Cricket match against the rival colony. What are you doing?

options.A: I am the fast bowler, putting pure physical power and aggression into every single delivery.
options.B: I analyze the pitch and set the exact field placements to block their best batsman's shots.
options.C: I am fielding at point or slips, relying on my quick reflexes to take a diving, one-handed catch.
options.D: I am the captain, calming the team down, changing the bowling order, and setting the overall strategy.

questions.scenario: There is a sudden power cut (load shedding) at night in your house. What is your immediate reaction?

options.A: I immediately volunteer to go up to the dark terrace to check if the neighbor's lights are also out.
options.B: I check the inverter battery levels, calculate how long the fans will run, and fix the tripped MCB switch.
options.C: I use my phone's flashlight to make cool shadow puppets or easily navigate the dark house using spatial memory.
options.D: I declare a rule that everyone must gather in one single room to save the inverter battery and stay cool.

questions.scenario: Your cycle or scooty breaks down 2 kilometers away from your tuition class. What do you do?

options.A: I physically push it all the way in the heat without complaining. It's just a little workout!
options.B: I try to diagnose the mechanical fault and see if I can fix the spark plug or chain myself on the spot.
options.C: I quickly maneuver through a shortcut alleyway I spotted earlier to find a mechanic super fast.
options.D: I call my friends to arrange a backup ride, ensuring I don't miss the test, and deal with the scooty later.

questions.scenario: Your school is hosting a massive Annual Day event. How are you helping out behind the scenes?

options.A: Doing the heavy lifting—moving chairs, carrying props, and running around the campus all day.
options.B: Handling the complex soundboard, lighting coordinates, and fixing the mic cables.
options.C: Controlling the spotlight from the balcony to flawlessly follow the main dancers on stage.
options.D: Holding the master schedule, coordinating between teachers, and solving sudden crises backstage.

questions.scenario: You are at a crowded Diwali Mela. What attracts you the absolute most?

options.A: The physical games like 'Ring Toss' or throwing a heavy ball to knock down a pyramid of cans.
options.B: Trying to reverse-engineer the carnival games to see how they are mathematically rigged.
options.C: Riding the giant Ferris wheel or roller coaster, absolutely loving the height, drops, and speed.
options.D: Noticing how the entry gates are poorly managed and thinking of a better system to handle the crowd.

questions.scenario: When you dream about an adventurous career, what is your ultimate motivation?

options.A: Pushing my physical limits, staying highly active, and experiencing raw, on-the-ground action.
options.B: Working with the most advanced technology, gadgets, and solving complex technical problems.
options.C: Experiencing extreme speeds, flying high, and having a dynamic, fast-paced life.
options.D: Leading large teams, making high-stakes decisions, and being a highly respected boss.

Infantry_Officer.title: Infantry Combat Officer
Infantry_Officer.primary_match_text: The Action-Oriented Warrior! You thrive in physical challenges, love being on the ground, and have immense stamina and bravery.
Infantry_Officer.day_in_the_life: Leading your platoon through tough terrains (like jungles or mountains), conducting tactical patrols, staying highly fit, and being the very first line of defense on the border.
Infantry_Officer.roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> NDA (National Defence Academy) exam after 12th -> Train at NDA, Khadakwasla OR complete Graduation -> CDS (Combined Defence Services) exam -> IMA/OTA training.

Artillery_Signals_Engineer.title: Artillery / Signals Engineer
Artillery_Signals_Engineer.primary_match_text: The Tactical Brain! You love technology, precise calculations, and ensuring the machinery and communications work flawlessly.
Artillery_Signals_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Calculating exact mathematical coordinates for long-range artillery strikes, maintaining highly secure military communication networks, and operating high-tech radar systems.
Artillery_Signals_Engineer.roadmap: 11th/12th (PCM: Physics, Chemistry, Maths mandatory) -> B.Tech/B.E. -> Apply through the Technical Entry Scheme (TES) after 12th OR CDS/AFCAT for Technical Branches after graduation.

Fighter_Pilot.title: Fighter Pilot / Drone Operator
Fighter_Pilot.primary_match_text: The High-Speed Aviator! You have incredibly sharp reflexes, great spatial awareness, and a love for height and speed.
Fighter_Pilot.day_in_the_life: Flying supersonic jets, performing complex aerial maneuvers during missions, or operating advanced reconnaissance drones from a control room to gather intel from the sky.
Fighter_Pilot.roadmap: 11th/12th (PCM mandatory) -> NDA (Air Force wing) right after 12th OR complete Graduation -> AFCAT (Air Force Common Admission Test) / CDS -> Training at the Air Force Academy (AFA).

Strategic_Commander.title: Strategic Commander
Strategic_Commander.primary_match_text: The Mastermind General! You are a natural leader who loves planning, organizing resources, and commanding large teams.
Strategic_Commander.day_in_the_life: Sitting in the command center, planning massive troop movements, managing military logistics (food, ammo, transport), and making the big strategic decisions during high-stakes operations.
Strategic_Commander.alternative_match_text: IAS/IPS Officer, Logistics Manager, Corporate Leader
Strategic_Commander.roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> NDA or CDS exam -> Serve years as a successful commissioned officer -> Clear internal exams for Defence Services Staff College (DSSC) to rise to top ranks like Colonel or General.
